annotations.title: EVM gas fees and USD transaction costs (6 chains)

description: Live gas fees and estimated USD transaction costs on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Polygon and Avalanche: base fee and next-block estimate, priority fee p25/p50/p75 over 10 blocks, gas price, 10-block base-fee trend, suggested max fee, and USD cost of a native transfer, ERC-20 transfer and swap (upper-bound rollup L1 fees included), plus the cheapest chain per action. Sources: JSON-RPC via PublicNode (public RPC fallback); prices from on-chain Uniswap v3 pools. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

chains.description: Comma-separated chains by name or chain id: base (8453), ethereum (1), arbitrum (42161), optimism (10), polygon (137), avalanche (43114). Default: all six.

speed.description: Priority-fee level used for suggested fees and costs: slow (p25), standard (p50) or fast (p75). Default standard.
